from google import genai
from model_models import ModelRequest, ModelResponse

def collect_platform_metadata(model_request: ModelRequest) -> ModelResponse:
    project_id = model_request.config.get("project_id")
    location = model_request.config.get("location")
    model_name = model_request.config.get("model_name", "gemini-2.5-flash")

    client = genai.Client(vertexai=True, project=project_id, location=location)
    model = client.get_model(model_name)

    response = model.generate_content(model_request.text)

    # Extract metadata from the response object
    metadata = {
        "model": model_name,
        "project_id": project_id,
        "location": location,
        # Add other relevant metadata if available in the genai.types.GenerateContentResponse object
        "prompt_feedback": response.prompt_feedback.to_dict() if response.prompt_feedback else None,
        "usage_metadata": {
            "prompt_token_count": response.usage_metadata.prompt_token_count if response.usage_metadata else None,
            "candidates_token_count": response.usage_metadata.candidates_token_count if response.usage_metadata else None,
            "total_token_count": response.usage_metadata.total_token_count if response.usage_metadata else None,
        },
    }

    return ModelResponse(text=response.text, metadata=metadata)

from google import genai
from google.generativeai.types import HarmCategory, HarmProbability
from model_models import ModelRequest, ModelResponse

def platform_output_safety(model_response: ModelResponse):
    # For simplicity, we assume the model_response.metadata contains safety attributes
    # as populated by collect_platform_metadata or similar.
    # In a real-world scenario, you might re-invoke the model with safety settings
    # or pass the full genai.types.GenerateContentResponse object.

    safety_attributes = model_response.metadata.get("prompt_feedback", {})
    
    # Check if any safety attributes indicate unsafe content
    is_unsafe = False
    safety_ratings = safety_attributes.get("safety_ratings", [])
    for rating in safety_ratings:
        if rating.get("probability") and rating["probability"] in [HarmProbability.HIGH, HarmProbability.MEDIUM]:
            is_unsafe = True
            break

    return {"text": model_response.text, "is_unsafe": is_unsafe, "safety_details": safety_attributes}

from google.cloud import aiplatform
from model_models import ModelResponse

def platform_output_embedding(model_response: ModelResponse):
    project_id = model_response.metadata.get("project_id")
    location = model_response.metadata.get("location")

    if not project_id or not location:
        raise ValueError("Project ID and location not found in model response metadata.")

    aiplatform.init(project=project_id, location=location)

    # Using a common embedding model provided by Vertex AI
    # The exact model name might vary, so it's good practice to make it configurable
    embedding_model_name = "text-embedding-004" # or "text-embedding-gecko@003"
    model = aiplatform.TextEmbeddingModel.from_pretrained(embedding_model_name)

    embeddings = model.predict([model_response.text])

    # The embeddings.predictions will contain a list of Embedding objects
    # Each Embedding object has a .values attribute which is the list of floats
    embedding_values = [e.values for e in embeddings.predictions]

    return {"text": model_response.text, "embedding": embedding_values}

from google.cloud import texttospeech
from model_models import ModelResponse

def platform_brief_audio(model_response: ModelResponse, audio_file_path: str = "briefing.mp3"):
    client = texttospeech.TextToSpeechClient()

    synthesis_input = texttospeech.SynthesisInput(text=model_response.text)

    # Configure the voice parameters
    voice = texttospeech.VoiceSelectionParams(
        language_code="en-US", ssml_gender=texttospeech.SsmlVoiceGender.NEUTRAL
    )

    # Configure the audio format
    audio_config = texttospeech.AudioConfig(
        audio_encoding=texttospeech.AudioEncoding.MP3
    )

    # Perform the text-to-speech request
    response = client.synthesize_speech(
        input=synthesis_input, voice=voice, audio_config=audio_config
    )

    # Write the audio content to a file
    with open(audio_file_path, "wb") as out:
        out.write(response.audio_content)

    return {"text": model_response.text, "audio_file_path": audio_file_path}
